about: Every object a real round named, per mod, level and game type: its template id, the hit point maximum the lab server recorder wrote for it (maxhp, the Armor's), and the turning parts it named (jn rows). Lab server recordings (bf1942_lnxded recorder) and bf42plus client recordings; the ground truth for the sidecar's computed template classes, hull specs, hulls and joint parts (tests/test_sidecar_template_objects.py)
